name: Knowing God
overview: Scripture reveals that knowing God is rooted in a personal relationship characterized by love and seeking Him diligently, as Proverbs 8:17 highlights. God's Word guides believers like a lamp illuminating their path (Psalms 119:105), enabling them to understand His will. Jeremiah emphasizes that true knowledge of God surpasses human wisdom, strength, or riches (Jeremiah 9:23), and is marked by God writing His law on the hearts of His people, establishing a covenant relationship (Jeremiah 31:33). Ultimately, knowing God is grounded in the eternal Word, who is God Himself (John 1:1), assuring believers of His purposeful plans and peace (Jeremiah 29:11).
